description: Sample concrete graph elements for divergent exploration. Use the returned nodes as provocations: judge how, or whether, they matter to the live task. No defensible connection is valid. force:true enables the stronger local Physics What-If experiment; ordinary work should normally keep force:false.

cold.description: Prioritize cold (rarely accessed) nodes for maximum semantic distance. Best combined with force:true.

count.description: Deprecated alias for nodes. Edges remain controlled independently by edges.

edges.description: Number of random edges to get

force.description: Optional Physics What-If experiment that temporarily assumes sampled concepts connect and asks how. Default false; reject the result unless later scrutiny grounds it.

nodeIds.description: Optional exact node IDs or titles supplied by graph_suggest_next. When present, inspect these nodes instead of drawing another random sample.

nodes.description: Number of random nodes to get (default: 2 when force:true, 3 otherwise)

name: graph_random
